errors.evidence: The reference description and the figure show that the Teacher method is represented by a red line with circular markers, not triangular markers.
The reference description states the F1 score for Teacher at 0 is 72.0, not 71.7.
The reference description states the F1 score for Teacher at 0.1 is 68.5, not 69.0.
The reference description states the F1 score for Teacher at 0.2 is 68.7, not 69.0.
The reference description states the F1 score for Teacher at 0.3 is 66.5, not 67.0.
The reference description states the F1 score for Teacher at 0.4 is 65.0, not 65.5.
The reference description states the F1 score for Teacher at 0.5 is 58.5, not 59.5.
The reference description states the F1 score for Teacher at 0.585 is 54.0, not 53.3.
The reference description states the F1 score for Self-Training at 0.1 is 68.3, not 68.8.
The reference description states the F1 score for Self-Training at 0.2 is 68.4, not 68.8.
The reference description states the F1 score for Self-Training at 0.3 is 65.5, not 66.0.
The reference description states the F1 score for Self-Training at 0.5 is 58.3, not 58.8.
The reference description states the F1 score for Self-Training at 0.585 is 52.7, not 53.0.
The reference description states the F1 score for PST at 0.2 is 70.3, not 70.5.
The reference description states the F1 score for PST at 0.3 is 69.9, not 70.0.
The reference description states the F1 score for PST at 0.4 is 69.0, not 69.5.
The reference description states the F1 score for PST at 0.585 is 62.0, not 62.2.

The reference description specifies the exact marker shapes for each method (circular for Teacher and PST, square for Self-Training), but the machine-generated description incorrectly describes Teacher's markers as triangular and omits explicit mention of PST's circular markers.
